test_command: dotnet build api/Biolog.Api/Biolog.Api.csproj && dotnet test tests/features/bio-att-002/Biolog.Features.AttendanceSessions.Tests.csproj && dotnet test tests/features/bio-att-001/Biolog.Features.Attendance.Tests.csproj && dotnet test tests/dotnet/Biolog.IntegrationTests/Biolog.IntegrationTests.csproj && bash tests/features/bio-att-002/BIO-ATT-002.test.sh && bash tests/features/bio-att-001/BIO-ATT-001.test.sh && bash scripts/quality.sh
notes:
Implements BIO-ATT-002 (education attendance policies) as a session/roster interpretation layer on top of BIO-ATT-001's raw AttendanceEvent core, reached only through this feature's own narrow gateway interfaces (no ProjectReference). Session (Domain/Session.cs) is a CAS-versioned aggregate - session_type (lecture/class/exam/hostel/event, the user story's own wording) plus an embedded roster of person ids (AC01), each existence-checked against BIO-IDN-001 before create/roster-update, roster-update itself a compare-and-set write. SessionAttendancePolicy (Domain/SessionAttendancePolicy.cs) is keyed on (tenant, session type) - a genuinely richer AC02 granularity than BIO-ATT-001's own single tenant-wide AttendancePolicy, with a second threshold (AbsentAfterMinutes, arrival strictly after this is Absent rather than Late) that story's single-threshold policy has no room for. Setting it is this feature's first ADR-0006-gated authorization decision (attendance.session_policy_manage).

SessionAttendanceClassifier (Domain/SessionAttendanceClassifier.cs) is a pure, read-time-only function mirroring AttendanceStatusEvaluator's own discipline exactly: proven by a test showing the SAME evidence classifies differently (Present vs Absent) under two different session-type policies. Raw evidence crosses BIO-ATT-001's own gateway boundary as a local, feature-owned AttendanceEvidenceRecord (event id, occurred_at, source, mode, verification method/verified/confidence) via this feature's own IAttendanceEventQueryGateway (Scoped, wraps BIO-ATT-001's own already-registered, internal AttendanceEventService.ListForPersonOnDateAsync directly, reachable only via that project's own InternalsVisibleTo grant) - every field a roster reader needs to see exactly how a classification was grounded is carried through untouched, never flattened (AC03).

AttendanceAdjustment (Domain/AttendanceAdjustment.cs) is a separate, append-only record layered ON TOP of a computed SessionMemberClassification - never mutating it or any BIO-ATT-001 event, the identical two-tier shape bio-doc-009's own AuthenticityManualOverride established. Recording one is this feature's second ADR-0006-gated authorization decision (attendance.session_adjustment_manage) and captures the pre-adjustment status freshly at write time (never trusting a caller-supplied 'original' value). A roster read (SessionAttendanceQueryService.GetRosterAsync) always shows BOTH the computed classification AND the latest adjustment, if any - SessionRosterMemberView.EffectiveStatus picks the adjustment when one exists, but Classification.Status (the computed value) stays visible, untouched, for anyone reading the audit trail (AC04).

AC05: governance/ui-integration-map.json maps all three BIO-ATT-00x stories to the same /attendance route and AttendanceService port; BIO-ATT-001's own README already named its two bridge routes ('View attendance record'/'Flag exception') as standing in for richer capture/policy UI a later story would build. This story takes them over - the identical disclosed-handoff shape BIO-TRN-001 -> BIO-TRN-002 already established for its own primary-action route. Required three narrow, disclosed edits to BIO-ATT-001's own already-accepted files: (1) api/features/bio-att-001/Api/AttendanceEndpoints.cs - the /primary-action and /flag-exception route mappings and their two handler methods removed, its own /events, /status and /policy routes untouched; (2) api/features/bio-att-001/Demo/AttendanceDemoBridgeService.cs - deleted (both its routes moved, nothing else referenced it); (3) api/Biolog.Api/Modules/BioAtt001Module.cs - its now-dangling Singleton registration and Demo using removed. web/features/attendance/live.ts and web/next.config.mjs are UNCHANGED (BIO-ATT-001's own proxy rule already covers both routes). Full record in docs/features/bio-att-002/README.md 'Why this story edits BIO-ATT-001's own endpoint mapping'.

The new AttendanceSessionDemoBridgeService (Singleton, headerless-POST-safe) needs real BIO-ATT-001 evidence to classify against, which only exists in that story's own event store - IAttendanceDemoSeedGateway is a SEPARATE Singleton-safe adapter (never the Scoped IAttendanceEventQueryGateway) wrapping BIO-ATT-001's own Singleton IAttendanceEventRepository directly and calling its own internal AttendanceEvent.Capture factory - a real, disclosed exception to 'gateways are read-only', the same justification and captive-dependency-safe split (two separate classes/registrations from the start) BIO-TRN-002's own ITransportDemoSeedProvisioner already established.

Verified: dotnet build clean (0 warnings, 0 errors, including the three edited BIO-ATT-001 files), BIO-ATT-002 feature tests 26/26 (SessionServiceTests/SessionAttendanceClassifierTests/SessionAttendancePolicyServiceTests/SessionAttendanceQueryServiceTests/AttendanceAdjustmentServiceTests), BIO-ATT-001 feature tests re-verified 24/24 (no regression), full Biolog.IntegrationTests suite 172/172 (including 6 new real-packaged-host tests in AttendanceSessionsHostChannelTests.cs: real session creation through the real BIO-IDN-001 person gateway, rejection for an unknown roster person, a real roster read reflecting a real BIO-ATT-001-captured event end to end, session-policy-set rejected for lack of authority, adjustment-create rejected without a provenance proof, and both AC05 bridge routes answering a genuinely headerless request), BIO-ATT-002's own structural harness 39/39 (was 38/39 before this evidence file existed), BIO-ATT-001's own structural harness re-verified 33/33 after its AC05 checks were updated for the disclosed handoff.
